name: Hanx Biopharmaceuticals (Wuhan) Co., Ltd.
summary: Hanx Biopharmaceuticals (Wuhan) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of immune-oncology therapies. The company's product pipeline includes HX009, a bifunctional anti-PD-1/SIRPa fusion protein that is in Phase IIa clinical trials for the treatment of EBV+ non-Hodgkin lymphoma, acral/mucosal subtype melanoma, relapsed/refractory melanoma post-PD-1 therapy, and Biliary tract cancer; HX044, a CTLA-4/SIRPa bifunctional fusion protein which is in Phase Ia for the treatment of solid tumours; HX301, a novel oral multi-kinase inhibitor that is in Phase IIa for the treatment of glioblastoma; and HX111, an ADC drug candidate to treat solid tumours.
